subject.title: improve: let Code Mode use declared tool result shapes

question: Should `outputSchema` become the supported optional plugin API for validating `AgentToolResult.details` and informing Code Mode and Tool Search?
rationale: This adds a documented third-party SDK contract and changes opted-in execution failure semantics; repository evidence can assess implementation quality but cannot choose the permanent plugin API policy.

options.title: Approve after normalization fix
options.body: Adopt `outputSchema` as the supported contract after the runtime cloning path preserves it and focused compatibility coverage passes.

options.title: Keep it internal
options.body: Limit output schemas to trusted core metadata until the public plugin contract and upgrade semantics receive separate design approval.

options.title: Decline the contract
options.body: Retain unknown output shapes and raw-first behavior rather than adding schema validation to plugin tool results.

recommendation.title: Approve after normalization fix
recommendation.body: Adopt `outputSchema` as the supported contract after the runtime cloning path preserves it and focused compatibility coverage passes.

likelyOwner.reason: This person owns the recent merged Code Mode sequence and is the current assignee, making them the strongest available routing candidate for the API decision.
